messages:
zara: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands on sales pipeline + partners. AEs asked for clear rules so they can move faster.
zara: Three asks: 1) How to tag inbound trials (POC vs Opp)? 2) Exact partner pilot terms and registration flow? 3) Short Hosted -> Dedicated guidance + a one-liner for outreach.
noel: Inbound trials = POC until a signed PO or subscription is active. Do NOT include POCs in commit. Add an expected-close date on the POC record.
anya: Partner pilot = registered partners only, 10% co-sell credit during pilot (Q2). Credits apply at invoicing, no retro credits. Registration via partner form in #partners.
anya: Partner Ops will validate regs and issue a deal reg number. Please use the deal reg number on quotes.
mike: Sales Ops will own the co-sell calc and add a tab to the quote template. Finance will reconcile monthly.
product-bot: Hosted-first recommendation published -> https://redwood.co/docs/guides/hosted-vs-dedicated. Short decision tree: Hosted for eval & early prod; Dedicated for data residency, sustained SLA throughput, or pinned models.
sales-ops: For Dedicated quotes Sales Ops uses Eng Infra inputs for GPU sizing and Product inputs for model/quantization assumptions. Sales Ops owns the final quote.
zara: Can someone post a 1-line partner outreach pitch AEs can use?
noel: Draft pitch: "Redwood: fast Hosted TTV, Dedicated for SLA-backed throughput and data isolation." Short battlecard to follow.
anya: Partner Ops will run weekly office hours starting next Wed to review regs and questions. Calendar invite and central docs will be posted in #partners.
zara: Action items recap: 1) Anya/Partner Ops: publish pilot doc + office hours; 2) Mike/Sales Ops: calc tab + quote template; 3) Product: one-pager decision tree; 4) Noel: battlecard + outreach line. React with :white_check_mark: when done or flag blockers.
noel: :white_check_mark: battlecard draft posted in #sales.
anya: :white_check_mark: pilot doc and office hours calendar created.
sales-ops: :white_check_mark: calc tab added to quote template and shared.
product-bot: Slides & recording uploaded -> https://redwood.co/all-hands/1881234567
zara: Thanks all, closing thread. Ping me for customer handoffs. :v:
